newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA ENJOY EIGHT-TRY WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA ENJOY EIGHT-TRY WIN.

text.p: Western Samoa warmed up for next week's test against Ireland in Dublin with eight sparkling tries in a convincing 58-27 win over Oxford University on Tuesday.
The Samoans looked rusty and lethargic before halftime but still led 18-13 at the break after tries from full-back Veli Patu and centre Mark Fatiolofa.

The students hit back three minutes into the second half to take the lead when wing Chris Smart crossed the Samoan line but the touring side stepped up a gear and added six further tries through Fatialofa, Patu, Afato So'oalo, Filip Toala, Kalolo Toleafoa and George Leaupepe to complete victory.
The one unsavoury moment for the Samoans came as tempers flared towards the end and prop Afa Leu'u was shown a yellow card for using his elbow in a tackle.
